verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable recurring job or workflow scheduler. The closest item is the ability to schedule a one-off subscription quantity change via the edit contract endpoint. That is a one-time future-dated action, not a recurring schedule. Billing-period invoicing and auto-recharge are built-in billing behaviors, not jobs or workflows a user can schedule, so they are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
